list_ModelTypes_enum_values: list all ModelTypes enum members and their human-readable descriptions
lookup_model_type: look up the ModelTypes category for a given model name using model_types_map
filter_models_by_type: filter model names from model_types_map by a specific ModelTypes category
list_selfsupervised_models: list all self-supervised model names from the SELFSUPERVISED_MODELS constant
list_low_accuracy_cnn_models: list all low accuracy CNN model names generated by the epoch-based loops
